Components: W (Any Polearm), M Cost: 19 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain, Clash Description:  You spin, around striking any and everything that stands in your path. Make three Taijutsu attacks comparing the results vs the AC of all each creature in range. On a hit you deal your [Weapons damage] + 3d6. Affected creatures must make a Strength Saving throw if they are struck at least once. If you crit with this attack all creatures make their saves at disadvantage.

Rank: B-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapons Range
Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Polearm), M.
Cost: 11 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain
Description: You lead your allies to capitalize on a brief moment where the enemy is left completely open. To cast this jutsu you must have at least 1 ally within 30 feet who can cast a C-Rank or lower Taijutsu or Bukijutsu as 1 Action.
All willing allies can spend their reaction as part of this jutsu’s casting.
First, you make a melee Taijutsu attack against the target creature, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 6d8 on a hit and if the affected creature has Jutsu based damage reduction, your attack gains a +2 to its critical threat range.
Next, each allied creature in whatever order they decide spends their reaction to cast a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu they know with a casting time of 1 Action, targeting the same creature you targeted with your attack. If the affected creature has Jutsu based damage reduction, their attack gains a +1 to their critical threat range.
Chain 2: Defense is part of a good offense. Yourself, and all allied creatures who case jutsu as part of this jutsu’s effect gain 8 temporary hit points until the end of your next turn.

Components: W (Any Polearm), M Cost: 16 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain Description: You spin your weapon with enough force to upheave gravel, stone and even water particles before swiping and maintaining the stance needed to hunt even demons with.
Select one creature you can see in range. That creature becomes the Demon you are hunting for the duration. While in initiative with your Demon you gain a +20 bonus to your movement speed and damage you deal with your polearm against this Demon ignores Resistance and treats immunity as resistance.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when another creature in range is taking a Reaction.
Range: Weapons Range
Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Polearm), M Cost: 4 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain Description: If a creature in your weapons range would take a reaction, before their effect is applied, make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit, you deal your [Weapons damage] + 3d8 and the affected creature must make a Strength Saving throw. On a failed save, the triggering jutsu is interrupted and its effects are dispelled, but the chakra is still spent.
Chain 1: On a failed save the affected creature doubles the chakra spent.
At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d8.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: B-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Polearm), M
Cost: 14 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain
Description: You spin your weapon fast enough to ignite the very air before stabbing forwards, looking to strike your foe with the fury of the sun. Make a melee Taijutsu attack against a creature in range. On a hit your deal your weapons damage +4d8 Fire damage and on hit.
All hostile creatures of your choice, excluding the original target, in a 15-foot cone originating from the target creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking half the Fire damage rolled on a failure and none on a success.
Chain 2: After striking you retain some of the kinetic heat on your weapon. You weapon deals +2d6 Fire damage the next time you deal damage with it before the end of your next turn, after which, the heat dissipates.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: B-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapons Range
Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Polearm), M
Cost: 12 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain, Clash
Description: You spin your weapon and reel back to deliver a deadly swing that would dismantle apart any foe. Make a melee taijutsu attack against a creature in range, dealing [Weapons damage] + 5d6. If the target of your attack has cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu since the end of your last turn, this attack gains a rank of Mastery.
On a hit, if the target is concentrating on a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu they immediately lose concentration of it if it was cast at a rank lower than the rank this jutsu was cast at.
Chain 2: The affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw gaining 1 rank of Sealed for every jutsu they were concentrating on when this jutsu was cast.
At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
